info.name: Campus Connect - Full API Suite
info.description: Complete positive + negative coverage for every Campus Connect endpoint, including the admin panel. Uses two regular users (User1/User2) and one admin. Run with the Collection Runner top-to-bottom; IDs/tokens are captured into collection variables as it goes. Set the environment first.
